nodes.summary: Main menu screen with Play/Settings/Tutorial/Exit buttons.

nodes.summary: Play screen placeholder with a title and back button.

nodes.summary: Settings screen placeholder with a title and back button.

nodes.name: TutorialPanel.java
nodes.summary: Tutorial screen placeholder with a title and back button.

nodes.name: Question.java
nodes.summary: Immutable multiple-choice question: id, module, Bloom level, text, explanation, shuffled choices, correct-choice id, isCorrect() check.

nodes.name: Choice.java
nodes.summary: One answer option: a stable original-letter choiceId plus display text, immune to display-order shuffling.

nodes.name: QuestionSource.java
nodes.summary: Interface: buildSession() returns exactly 15 Questions in ascending Bloom order with choices pre-shuffled.

nodes.name: GameEngine.java
nodes.summary: Interface: startSession/currentQuestion/submitAnswer/endSession — the seam the GUI builds against ahead of the real implementation.

nodes.name: TurnResult.java
nodes.summary: Immutable per-turn outcome: correctness, tokens awarded/running total, capability-unlock flag/name, game-over flag.

nodes.name: Protocol.java
nodes.summary: Placeholder enum: STANDARD or HIGH_RISK session protocol, values only so far.

nodes.name: SessionResult.java
nodes.summary: Placeholder class for the finished-session summary; empty until Week 4.

nodes.summary: Current-format question bank data for the 'Introduction to Artificial Intelligence' module.
